english.note: Use this when the manner is serene and unagitated rather than specifically self-controlled.

examples.english: I calmly listened to the sound of the waves and drifted off to sleep.
examples.traditional: 我平靜咁聽住海浪聲，唔知唔覺瞓着咗。
